# Hostile argument vectors for scripts/runner/target.sh. test-runners.sh runs each one under each bash on
# the machine, from a working directory that is a git repository (a cargo workspace, Anchor.toml and a
# package lock) holding the run directories audit_1, whose exec-mode is native, with patches/F-1.patch,
# F-3.patch, F-2.patch of 16 MiB and one byte, and src.git, a copy git-ro.sh copy made, and incident_1, with no
# exec-mode; the file a.rs; the directory src/; and linkdir, a symbolic link to audit_1. AUDITOR_EXEC_MODE,
# AUDITOR_RUN_TIMEOUT and TOOLS_VERSION are not set.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...]. Each
# case prints nothing on stdout, makes no scratch directory and changes nothing in the working directory.
